description: Listed prices that changed in the last 30 days, one row per quote, newest change first: the figure before its first change in the window, the figure now, and how many times it changed. A quote back at its starting figure is left out, and so are marketplace floors unless asked for. Optionally for one GPU or one provider.

include_marketplaces.description: Also list marketplace floors (Vast.ai), which move with every read; default false.

name: recent_price_changes
